#!/bin/bash
# lsu_batch_supervisor.sh — AGU P4 批次监督者（外部编译风暴多波次环境的自动恢复）
#
# 背景（obs_incident_20261012_ninja_storm.md）：外部 ninja/clang++ 构建波次
# 反复触发 guard GATE（F-023 语义=守护周期未完成→GUARD_FAILURE→级联烧穿
# 剩余 item→driver 退出）。批次是样本级可 resume 的——监督者职责：
#   1. 等静默窗（guard COMPILE_COMMS 全表连续 5 分钟零编译进程 + Mem≥12GiB）
#   2. E2E crash 样本未 COMPLETE → 先补齐（BUG-4/5/6 修复版管线）
#   3. 4 个 AGU driver 未在跑 → 原命令重启（输出 r3 日志；样本级 resume）
#   4. 下一波风暴杀死 driver → 回到 1（批次最终在静默窗内推进完成）
# 停止条件：31/31 RunID 终态（脚本自查 unit_status/result）或人工 touch STOP。
# 全程绝对路径；逐行留痕 supervisor.log。
set -u
MT=/home/sdc/gem5-fi-ding
WT=$MT/.claude/worktrees/lsu-obs
LOG=$MT/runs/lsu/obs/supervisor.log
STOP=$MT/runs/lsu/obs/supervisor.STOP
export LSU_GEM5_BIN=$MT/build/ARM/gem5.opt LSU_GUARD_DIR=$MT/runs/lsu/guard PYTHONHASHSEED=0
COMMS="scons make ninja gcc g++ gcc-12 g++-12 clang clang++ cc1plus cc1 as ld ld.bfd"
log(){ echo "[$(date '+%F %T')] $*" >> $LOG; }
storm_active(){ for c in $COMMS; do pgrep -x "$c" >/dev/null 2>&1 && return 0; done; return 1; }
mem_gib(){ awk '/MemAvailable/{print int($2/1048576)}' /proc/meminfo; }
# 2026-10-14 计数修正（中央指令 #2）：旧模式 "lsu_w1_rerun.py.*p4_agu_formal_20261012"
# 会把 cmdline 中含该命令文本的 Claude 遗留 shell/审计包装进程也计为 driver
# （日志显示 3-4 个而真实 Python driver 只有 2-3 个）。新锚定模式只认
# "python3 [路径]lsu_w1_rerun.py" 作为首参数的真实 Python driver 进程——
# /bin/bash -c 包装、python3 -c 内联代码、grep/pgrep 自身均不匹配。
DRIVER_PAT='^python3 [^ ]*lsu_w1_rerun\.py .*p4_agu_formal_20261012'
drivers_running(){ pgrep -fc "$DRIVER_PAT" 2>/dev/null || true; }
drivers_pids(){ pgrep -f  "$DRIVER_PAT" 2>/dev/null | tr '\n' ' '; }
quiet_5min(){
  local ok=0 i
  for i in $(seq 1 30); do
    if storm_active; then ok=0; else ok=$((ok+1)); fi
    [ $ok -ge 5 ] && return 0
    sleep 60
  done
  return 1
}
e2e_crash_complete(){
  [ -f $MT/runs/lsu/obs/obs_e2e_20261012/ITEM-001/ITEM-001_s416/COMPLETE ]
}
item_status(){
  # 权威状态（2026-10-14 终态修正，中央指令）：
  #   pilot_w1 = D-2026-10-09 载体重跑的权威结果目录；pilot/AGU = 原 checklist 结果。
  #   双查防漏：任一来源真终态（COMPLETE/BLOCKED_ATTEMPT_CAP）即输出 TERMINAL。
  #   GUARD_FAILURE / 普通 BLOCKED / MISSING 均非终态（多项目仍在目标下，须继续恢复）。
  python3 -c "
import json, sys
it = sys.argv[1]
cands = []
for p in ('$MT/runs/lsu/pilot_w1/%s/%s_result.json' % (it, it),
          '$MT/runs/lsu/pilot/AGU/%s_result.json' % it):
    try:
        cands.append(json.load(open(p)).get('status', ''))
    except Exception:
        pass
if any(c in ('COMPLETE', 'BLOCKED_ATTEMPT_CAP') for c in cands):
    print('TERMINAL')
else:
    print(cands[0] if cands else 'MISSING')
" "$1" 2>/dev/null
}
batch_done(){
  # 终态判定（2026-10-14 修正，中央指令）：GUARD_FAILURE 不是终态——守卫周期失败只
  # 代表基础设施中断，样本级 resume 可继续；只有真 COMPLETE / BLOCKED_ATTEMPT_CAP
  # （双文件任一来源给出）才算完成。真终态以台账/handoff 为准，此处仅决定 supervisor 退出。
  [ "$(drivers_running)" -eq 0 ] || return 1
  local n=0 it st
  for it in ITEM-001 ITEM-002 ITEM-003 ITEM-004 ITEM-005 ITEM-006 ITEM-007 ITEM-008 \
            ITEM-009 ITEM-010 ITEM-013 ITEM-014 ITEM-015 ITEM-016 ITEM-017 ITEM-018 \
            ITEM-019 ITEM-020 ITEM-021 ITEM-022 ITEM-023 ITEM-024 ITEM-025 ITEM-026 \
            ITEM-027 ITEM-034 ITEM-035 ITEM-036 ITEM-037 ITEM-038 ITEM-039; do
    st=$(item_status "$it")
    case "$st" in
      TERMINAL) n=$((n+1)) ;;
    esac
  done
  log "batch_done 巡检：真终态 $n/31（GUARD_FAILURE/BLOCKED 不计）"
  [ $n -ge 31 ]
}
log "supervisor start (pid $$)"
while true; do
  [ -f "$STOP" ] && { log "STOP 文件存在，supervisor 退出"; exit 0; }
  if batch_done; then log "批次终态（31/31），supervisor 退出"; exit 0; fi
  if ! quiet_5min; then log "静默窗未达成（风暴持续），继续等待"; continue; fi
  AVAIL=$(mem_gib)
  if [ "$AVAIL" -lt 12 ]; then log "mem ${AVAIL}GiB<12，等待"; sleep 300; continue; fi
  log "静默窗达成（mem=${AVAIL}GiB）"
  # E2E crash 样本补齐（BUG-4/5/6 修复版；idempotent：COMPLETE 即跳过）
  if ! e2e_crash_complete; then
    log "E2E crash 样本补齐启动"
    python3 $WT/tools/lsu_obs_driver.py --items ITEM-001 --phase screening \
      --campaign obs_e2e_20261012 --samples 416 418 419 \
      --replay-policy per_sample --outdir-root $MT/runs/lsu/obs >> $LOG 2>&1
    log "E2E crash 补齐 rc=$? complete=$(e2e_crash_complete && echo yes || echo no)"
    if e2e_crash_complete; then
      python3 $WT/tools/lsu_obs_e2e.py --validate --campaign obs_e2e_20261012 \
        --crash-sample ITEM-001:s416 >> $LOG 2>&1
      log "E2E validate rc=$?"
      python3 $WT/tools/lsu_obs_e2e.py --report --campaign obs_e2e_20261012 \
        --crash-sample ITEM-001:s416 >> $LOG 2>&1
      log "E2E report rc=$?"
    fi
  fi
  # 静默窗可能已被 E2E 运行耗掉——重查
  if storm_active; then log "E2E 后风暴再起，回到等待"; continue; fi
  N=$(drivers_running)
  if [ "${N:-0}" -eq 0 ]; then
    log "重启 4 个 AGU driver（r3）"
    cd $MT
    nohup python3 tools/lsu_w1_rerun.py --carrier checklist --unit-dir runs/lsu/pilot/AGU --phase screening --target 385 --campaign p4_agu_formal_20261012 --items ITEM-002 ITEM-006 ITEM-007 ITEM-008 ITEM-010 ITEM-014 ITEM-017 ITEM-018 ITEM-019 ITEM-021 ITEM-022 ITEM-023 ITEM-026 ITEM-027 ITEM-034 ITEM-035 ITEM-038 ITEM-039 > runs/lsu/pilot_w1/formal_logs/driver_A_r3.log 2>&1 &
    log "driver A pid=$!"
    nohup python3 tools/lsu_w1_rerun.py --carrier w1 --phase screening --target 385 --campaign p4_agu_formal_20261012 --items ITEM-003 ITEM-004 ITEM-005 ITEM-009 ITEM-015 ITEM-016 > runs/lsu/pilot_w1/formal_logs/driver_B_r3.log 2>&1 &
    log "driver B pid=$!"
    nohup python3 tools/lsu_w1_rerun.py --carrier w1 --phase screening --target 385 --campaign p4_agu_formal_20261012 --items ITEM-020 ITEM-024 ITEM-025 ITEM-036 ITEM-037 > runs/lsu/pilot_w1/formal_logs/driver_C_r3.log 2>&1 &
    log "driver C pid=$!"
    nohup python3 tools/lsu_w1_rerun.py --carrier checklist --unit-dir runs/lsu/pilot/AGU --phase screening --target 2401 --campaign p4_agu_formal_20261012 --items ITEM-001 ITEM-013 > runs/lsu/pilot_w1/formal_logs/driver_D_r3.log 2>&1 &
    log "driver D pid=$!"
  else
    log "driver 在跑（${N} 个），仅巡检"
  fi
  sleep 300
done

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""[LSU][XLSX-BACKFILL] 权威 Excel 矩阵回填器（原生 zip+XML，无 openpyxl 依赖）。

协议（用户指令 2026-10-12 第二节）：
  1. 带时间戳备份（仓库外 /home/sdc/gem5-fi-backups/excel_backups/）；
  2. 单写入者（主 Agent 串行调用）；
  3. 先写临时文件；
  4. 重新打开校验：9 工作表、325 条矩阵记录（RunID 唯一）、表头 43 列逐字
     不变、无公式破坏、目标单元格新值正确；
  5. 校验全过才 os.replace 原子替换；
  6. 任何校验失败 → 保留原文件不动，退出码非 0。

写入语义：
  - 数值列（Q,R,S,T,U,V,W,AB,AC..AJ,AL..AP 等）写 <v> 数字；
  - 文本列（X,Y,Z,AA 等）写 inlineStr（不动 sharedStrings，Excel 兼容）；
  - 只更新 draft 中 backfill=true 的行的数值列 + 所有目标行的 Z/AA；
  - 绝不新增/删除/改名任何列、行、工作表。

用法：
  python3 tools/lsu_xlsx_backfill.py --draft /tmp/lsu_backfill_draft.json [--apply]
  不带 --apply = 干跑（只校验草案与目标行定位，不写）。
"""
import argparse
import datetime
import json
import os
import re
import shutil
import sys
import tempfile
import zipfile
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

NS = "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main"
XLSX = "docs/gem5-fi/lsu/gem5-fi-LSU单元故障注入方案.xlsx"
SHEET = "xl/worksheets/sheet8.xml"          # 7.展开执行矩阵
BACKUP_DIR = "/home/sdc/gem5-fi-backups/excel_backups"

# 列号 → 列字母（1 基）
def col_letter(n):
    s = ""
    while n:
        n, r = divmod(n - 1, 26)
        s = chr(65 + r) + s
    return s

NUM_COL_ORDER = [17, 18, 19, 20, 21, 22, 23, 42]   # attempted..simfail 对应列
# 草案键名（Subagent F 约定：attempted/activated 小写、simfail、五类大写驼峰）
DRAFT_NUM_KEYS = ["attempted", "activated", "Masked", "DC", "SDC", "Crash",
                  "Timeout", "simfail"]   # 依次写入列 17,18,19,20,21,22,23,42
TXT_COLS = ["SDC率", "激活率", "记录状态", "实测备注"]
TXT_COL_ORDER = {"SDC率": 24, "激活率": 25, "记录状态": 26, "实测备注": 27}


def cell_ref(col, row):
    return f"{col_letter(col)}{row}"


def read_rows(zf, sheet=SHEET):
    """(shared, sheet_root, rows{row:{col:text}}) —— 与 evidence/P0/xlsx_dump 同款只读解析。"""
    shared = []
    if "xl/sharedStrings.xml" in zf.namelist():
        root = ET.fromstring(zf.read("xl/sharedStrings.xml"))
        for si in root.iter(f"{{{NS}}}si"):
            shared.append("".join(t.text or "" for t in si.iter(f"{{{NS}}}t")))
    sheet = ET.fromstring(zf.read(sheet))
    rows = {}
    for c in sheet.iter(f"{{{NS}}}c"):
        m = re.match(r"([A-Z]+)(\d+)", c.get("r"))
        col = 0
        for ch in m.group(1):
            col = col * 26 + ord(ch) - 64
        r = int(m.group(2))
        t = c.get("t")
        v = c.find(f"{{{NS}}}v")
        if v is None or v.text is None:
            is_ = c.find(f"{{{NS}}}is")          # inlineStr（本工具写入格式）
            val = "" if is_ is None else "".join(
                tt.text or "" for tt in is_.iter(f"{{{NS}}}t"))
        else:
            val = shared[int(v.text)] if t == "s" else v.text
        rows.setdefault(r, {})[col] = val
    return rows


def make_cell(col, row, value, numeric):
    """规范 <c> 元素：数字直写 <v>；文本 inlineStr。"""
    c = ET.Element(f"{{{NS}}}c")
    c.set("r", cell_ref(col, row))
    if numeric:
        c.set("t", "n")
        v = ET.SubElement(c, f"{{{NS}}}v")
        v.text = str(value)
    else:
        c.set("t", "inlineStr")
        is_ = ET.SubElement(c, f"{{{NS}}}is")
        t = ET.SubElement(is_, f"{{{NS}}}t")
        t.text = str(value)
        t.set("{http://www.w3.org/XML/1998/namespace}space", "preserve")
    return c


def apply_draft(draft, apply=False):
    zf = zipfile.ZipFile(XLSX)
    rows = read_rows(zf)
    # 定位目标行：列 1 = RunID
    rid_row = {rows[r].get(1, ""): r for r in rows if rows[r].get(1)}
    # 逐条核验草案定位
    plan = []          # (row, col, value, numeric)
    errors = []
    for rec in draft:
        rid = rec["runid"]
        row = rec.get("excel_row") or rid_row.get(rid)
        if not row or rid_row.get(rid) != row:
            errors.append(f"{rid}: excel_row={rec.get('excel_row')} 与矩阵实际行 "
                          f"{rid_row.get(rid)} 不一致")
            continue
        if rid_row.get(rid) is None:
            errors.append(f"{rid}: 矩阵无此 RunID")
            continue
        if rec.get("backfill"):
            for i, key in enumerate(DRAFT_NUM_KEYS):
                if rec.get(key) is not None:
                    plan.append((row, NUM_COL_ORDER[i], rec[key], True))
        for key in TXT_COLS:
            if rec.get(key) is not None:
                plan.append((row, TXT_COL_ORDER[key], rec[key], False))
    if errors:
        print("❌ 草案定位核验失败：")
        for e in errors:
            print("  ", e)
        return 1
    print(f"✓ 草案定位核验通过：{len(draft)} 条记录，{len(plan)} 个单元格写入计划")

    if not apply:
        for row, col, val, num in sorted(plan):
            print(f"  [dry] {cell_ref(col, row)} = {val!r}{'(数)' if num else ''}")

        return 0

    # ── 写入：解析 sheet8 XML，逐行插入/覆写单元格 ──
    ET.register_namespace("", NS)
    sheet = ET.fromstring(zf.read(SHEET))
    row_elems = {int(re.match(r"\d+", r.get("r")).group(0)): r
                 for r in sheet.iter(f"{{{NS}}}row")}
    ncols_changed = 0
    for row, col, val, num in plan:
        relem = row_elems.get(row)
        if relem is None:
            errors.append(f"行 {row} 不存在于 sheet8")
            continue
        ref = cell_ref(col, row)
        # 删除既有同引用单元格（覆写）
        for c in list(relem):
            if c.get("r") == ref:
                relem.remove(c)
        # 按列序插入
        newc = make_cell(col, row, val, num)
        inserted = False
        for c in relem:
            m = re.match(r"([A-Z]+)", c.get("r"))
            cc = 0
            for ch in m.group(1):
                cc = cc * 26 + ord(ch) - 64
            if cc > col:
                relem.insert(list(relem).index(c), newc)
                inserted = True
                break
        if not inserted:
            relem.append(newc)
        ncols_changed += 1
    if errors:
        print("❌ 写入阶段定位失败：", errors)
        return 1

    # ── 新 zip 临时文件（复制其余条目，替换 sheet8）──
    new_sheet = ET.tostring(sheet, xml_declaration=True, encoding="UTF-8")
    fd, tmp = tempfile.mkstemp(suffix=".xlsx", dir=os.path.dirname(
        os.path.abspath(XLSX)))
    os.close(fd)
    with zipfile.ZipFile(tmp, "w", zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as zout:
        for item in zf.namelist():
            if item == SHEET:
                zout.writestr(item, new_sheet)
            else:
                zout.writestr(item, zf.read(item))

    # ── 校验临时文件 ──
    v = verify(tmp, draft, plan)
    if v:
        os.remove(tmp)
        print("❌ 校验失败，原文件未动：", v)
        return 1

    # ── 备份 + 原子替换 ──
    os.makedirs(BACKUP_DIR, exist_ok=True)
    ts = datetime.datetime.now().strftime("%Y%m%d-%H%M%S")
    bak = os.path.join(BACKUP_DIR, f"lsu-matrix-{ts}.xlsx")
    shutil.copy2(XLSX, bak)
    os.replace(tmp, XLSX)
    print(f"✓ 回填完成：{ncols_changed} 单元格；备份 {bak}；原子替换 {XLSX}")
    return 0


def verify(path, draft, plan):
    """返回错误列表（空=通过）：9 表、325 RunID、表头、目标值。"""
    errs = []
    zf = zipfile.ZipFile(path)
    # ① 9 工作表
    wb = ET.fromstring(zf.read("xl/workbook.xml"))
    n = len(list(wb.iter(f"{{{NS}}}sheet")))
    if n != 9:
        errs.append(f"工作表数 {n} != 9")
    # ② 325 唯一 RunID（行 2-326）
    rows = read_rows(zf)
    rids = [rows[r].get(1) for r in range(2, 327) if rows.get(r, {}).get(1)]
    if len(rids) != 325 or len(set(rids)) != 325:
        errs.append(f"RunID 数 {len(rids)}/唯一 {len(set(rids))} != 325")
    # ③ 表头 43 列逐字不变（对照原文件）
    zo = zipfile.ZipFile(XLSX)
    ro = read_rows(zo)
    hdr_new = rows.get(1, {})
    hdr_old = ro.get(1, {})
    for c in sorted(set(hdr_old) | set(hdr_new)):
        if hdr_old.get(c, "") != hdr_new.get(c, ""):
            errs.append(f"表头列 {c} 变化: {hdr_old.get(c)!r} -> {hdr_new.get(c)!r}")
    # ④ 无公式损坏（本表原本 0 公式）
    xml = zf.read(SHEET).decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
    if "<f>" in xml:
        errs.append("出现公式元素（原表无公式）")
    # ⑤ 目标单元格值正确
    for row, col, val, num in plan:
        got = rows.get(row, {}).get(col)
        want = str(val) if num else str(val)
        if got != want:
            errs.append(f"{cell_ref(col, row)} 期望 {want!r} 实得 {got!r}")
    # ⑥ 未计划的目标行 RunID 列未被触碰（行号取矩阵实际解析值）
    rid_row = {rows[r].get(1, ""): r for r in rows if rows.get(r, {}).get(1)}

            errs.append(f"{rec['runid']}: 校验文件中 RunID 行缺失/被改动")
    return errs


def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    ap.add_argument("--draft", required=True, help="回填草案 JSON（Subagent 产物）")
    ap.add_argument("--apply", action="store_true", help="执行写入（默认干跑）")
    args = ap.parse_args()
    draft = json.load(open(args.draft))
    sys.exit(apply_draft(draft, apply=args.apply))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

import zipfile, re, sys
sys.path.insert(0, 'tools')
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
NS = "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main"
XLSX = "docs/gem5-fi/lsu/gem5-fi-LSU单元故障注入方案.xlsx"
SHEET = "xl/worksheets/sheet8.xml"

def col_letter(n):
    s=""
    while n:
        n,r=divmod(n-1,26); s=chr(65+r)+s
    return s

zf=zipfile.ZipFile(XLSX)
shared=[]
if "xl/sharedStrings.xml" in zf.namelist():
    root=ET.fromstring(zf.read("xl/sharedStrings.xml"))
    for si in root.iter(f"{{{NS}}}si"):
        shared.append("".join(t.text or "" for t in si.iter(f"{{{NS}}}t")))
sheet=ET.fromstring(zf.read(SHEET))
rows={}
for c in sheet.iter(f"{{{NS}}}c"):
    m=re.match(r"([A-Z]+)(\d+)", c.get("r"))
    col=0
    for ch in m.group(1): col=col*26+ord(ch)-64
    r=int(m.group(2)); t=c.get("t"); v=c.find(f"{{{NS}}}v")
    if v is None or v.text is None:
        is_=c.find(f"{{{NS}}}is"); val="" if is_ is None else "".join(tt.text or "" for tt in is_.iter(f"{{{NS}}}t"))
    else:
        val=shared[int(v.text)] if t=="s" else v.text
    rows.setdefault(r,{})[col]=val

print("=== 表头（43 列）：")
hdr=rows.get(1,{})
for c in sorted(hdr): print(f"  col{c}({col_letter(c)}): {hdr[c]}")

        for c in sorted(rows[r]):
            print(f"  {col_letter(c)}{r} (col{c}) = {rows[r][c]!r}")
        break
print()
print("=== 相邻行参考（已回填过的行样例）：")
done=0
for r in sorted(rows):
    v=rows[r]
    if v.get(26) and "COMPLETE" in str(v.get(26)) and done<2:
        print(f"--- row {r} RunID={v.get(1)}")
        for c in sorted(v): print(f"  {col_letter(c)}{r} (col{c}) = {v[c]!r}")
        done+=1

import zipfile, re
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
NS = "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main"
XLSX = "docs/gem5-fi/lsu/gem5-fi-LSU单元故障注入方案.xlsx"
SHEET = "xl/worksheets/sheet8.xml"
def col_letter(n):
    s=""
    while n:
        n,r=divmod(n-1,26); s=chr(65+r)+s
    return s
zf=zipfile.ZipFile(XLSX)
shared=[]
root=ET.fromstring(zf.read("xl/sharedStrings.xml"))
for si in root.iter(f"{{{NS}}}si"):
    shared.append("".join(t.text or "" for t in si.iter(f"{{{NS}}}t")))
sheet=ET.fromstring(zf.read(SHEET))
rows={}
for c in sheet.iter(f"{{{NS}}}c"):
    m=re.match(r"([A-Z]+)(\d+)", c.get("r"))
    col=0
    for ch in m.group(1): col=col*26+ord(ch)-64
    r=int(m.group(2)); t=c.get("t"); v=c.find(f"{{{NS}}}v")
    if v is None or v.text is None:
        is_=c.find(f"{{{NS}}}is"); val="" if is_ is None else "".join(tt.text or "" for tt in is_.iter(f"{{{NS}}}t"))
    else:
        val=shared[int(v.text)] if t=="s" else v.text
    rows.setdefault(r,{})[col]=val
# col26 状态分布
from collections import Counter
st=Counter(rows[r].get(26,"") for r in rows if r>=2)
print("记录状态分布:", dict(st))
# 找有数值的行（Q 非空）
filled=[r for r in sorted(rows) if r>=2 and rows[r].get(17) not in (None,"")]
print(f"\n已回填行数（Q 非空）: {len(filled)}")
for r in filled[:3]:
    v=rows[r]
    print(f"--- row {r}: {v.get(1)}")
    for c in sorted(v):
        if c>=16: print(f"  {col_letter(c)}{r} = {str(v[c])[:150]!r}")
EOF

def _sample_dir(self, m, s):
        return self.root / self.args.campaign / m["item"] / f"{m['item']}_s{s}"

    # ------------------------------------------------------------- sample
    def run_sample(self, m, s, slots=None):
        od = self._sample_dir(m, s)
        sample = f"s{s}"
        if (od / OC.COMPLETE).exists():
            ok, reason = OC.verify_complete(
                od, {"git_commit": m["identity"]["git_commit"],
                     "gem5_opt_sha256": m["identity"]["gem5_opt_sha256"]})
            print(f"[{m['item']} {sample}] COMPLETE 已存在 → 只读核验 "
                  f"{'OK' if ok else 'REFUSED: ' + reason}，跳过", flush=True)
            return ("skipped" if ok else "verify_refused")
        mode, mode_reason = self.obs_mode_for(m)
        key, gdir, _ident, cached = self.ensure_golden(
            m, self.args.dry_run, slots=slots)
        if mode == "full" and (gdir / "commit_trace.csv.gz").exists():
            gb = (gdir / "commit_trace.csv.gz").stat().st_size / GIB
            if gb > self.args.trace_budget_gib:
                self.degraded_carriers[m["carrier"]] = (
                    f"carrier_over_budget: ref ctrace {gb:.1f}GiB > "
                    f"{self.args.trace_budget_gib}GiB")
                mode, mode_reason = self.obs_mode_for(m)
        if self.args.dry_run:
            # dry：零副作用（不 claim、不建目录、不起 gem5），只打印计划
            staging = Path(str(od) + ".staging")
            cfg, args = LR.build_guard_cmd(m, staging, span=None)
            cmd = _numactl_prefix() + [str(LR.g5_path()), "--outdir",
                                       str(staging), cfg] + args
            if mode == "full":
                cmd += _obs_args(staging / "commit_trace.csv.gz",
                                 staging / "micro_snap.csv.gz",
                                 family=m["family"],
                                 prop_trace_file=staging / "prop_trace.csv.gz")
            print(f"[dry] {m['item']} s{s} mode={mode}"
                  f"{f' reason={mode_reason}' if mode_reason else ''} "
                  f"golden={key[:8]}{'(cached)' if cached else '(new)'}")
            print(f"[dry] cmd: {' '.join(str(c) for c in cmd)}")
            return "dry"
        # claim（防重调度；stale → 中止本项保现场）
        claim, reason = self.G._claim_acquire(
            self.args.campaign, m["run_id"], sample,
            f"obs-driver pid={os.getpid()}")
        if claim is None:
            if "陈旧" in reason:
                raise UP.GuardFailure(f"claim stale: {reason}")
            print(f"[{m['item']} {sample}] claim 被持有 → 跳过（{reason[:80]}）",
                  flush=True)
            return "claimed_elsewhere"
        try:
            staging = Path(str(od) + ".staging")
            if staging.exists():
                q = OC.quarantine(staging)
                print(f"[{m['item']} {sample}] staging 残留 → 隔离 {q.name}",
                      flush=True)
            od.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            staging.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            v, _cmd = self.run_fault(m, s, staging, mode, slots=slots)
            # replay 策略
            if self.args.replay_policy == "per_sample":
                ev = self.replay_check(m, s, mode, slots=slots,
                                       first_staging=staging)
            elif (self.args.replay_policy == "per_runid_first"
                  and m["run_id"] not in self.replay_done):
                ev = self.replay_check(m, s, mode, slots=slots,
                                       first_staging=staging)
                self.replay_done[m["run_id"]] = ev
            elif self.args.replay_policy == "per_runid_first":
                ev = {"policy": "per_runid_first", "verified": True,
                      "evidence": {"reused_from": "本 RunID 首样本重放",
                                   **(self.replay_done.get(m["run_id"], {})
                                      .get("evidence", {}))}}
            else:
                ev = {"policy": "none", "verified": False,
                      "evidence": {"reason": "--replay-policy none"}}
            obs = self.post_process(m, s, staging, mode, gdir, ev)
            OC.finalize_sample(staging, od)
            print(f"[{m['item']} {sample}] {v.get('outcome')}/"
                  f"{v.get('crash_kind', '-')} mode={mode} "
                  f"chain_complete={obs['chain_complete']} "
                  f"({obs['chain_status_reason'][:80]})", flush=True)
            return "complete"
        finally:
            ok, msg, _p = self.G._claim_release(
                self.args.campaign, m["run_id"], sample, os.getpid())
            if not ok:
                print(f"WARNING: claim 释放异常: {msg}", file=sys.stderr)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------- items

**Status: complete（2026-09-03）**

**验收**：✅ mem formal n_valid=384>0；✅ reg_chain golden f247ef3fe6f02cfd 回归通过。

## Phase 2 — protection-aware 第二组（§1.2 核心缺口，改结论级别的补强）

**Status: complete（2026-09-03）**

def _write_lock_atomic(path, lock):
    """原子重写锁文件（tmp + os.replace）：心跳/派生信息更新期间读者永见完整 JSON。"""
    tmp = f"{path}.tmp.{os.getpid()}"

def _stop_dispatch(snap):

    return snap["mem_available_gib"] < STOP_DISPATCH_MEM_GIB


def _disk_guard_reason(free_gib, total_gib):
    """0101 磁盘红线：free < max(50GiB, 20%×total) → 阻断理由（None=通过）。"""
    floor = max(DISK_MIN_FREE_GIB, DISK_MIN_FREE_PCT * total_gib)

def ensure_golden(self, m, dry=False, slots=None):
        """no-fault golden：每 baseline_key 一次，缓存只读复用；漂移拒用。

        OBS-8a：并发 worker 同 key 双跑防护——per-key 串行锁 + 双检（后到
        线程等待后直接复用先到线程产物，绝不隔离他人进行中的 staging）。
        """
        ident = self.baseline_ident(m)
        key = OC.baseline_key(ident)
        gdir = self.golden_root / key
        ctr, msn = gdir / "commit_trace.csv.gz", gdir / "micro_snap.csv.gz"

        def _cached():
            ok, reason = OC.verify_complete(
                gdir, {"gem5_opt_sha256": ident["gem5_opt_sha256"],
                       "baseline_key": key})
            if ok:
                return True
            print(f"[golden] {key} 身份漂移/核验失败（{reason}）→ 新 key 重跑",
                  flush=True)
            OC.quarantine(gdir)
            return False

        if (gdir / OC.COMPLETE).exists() and _cached():
            return key, gdir, ident, True   # 缓存复用
        if dry:
            # dry 零副作用（OBS-3 契约）：不建锁文件/不建目录/不隔离残留
            print(f"[golden-dry] {key} → {gdir}")
            return key, gdir, ident, False

CONFIRMED — the exact race I diagnosed:

```python
        try:
            fd = os.open(path, os.O_CREAT | os.O_EXCL | os.O_WRONLY, 0o644)
        except FileExistsError:
            continue
        lock = {**base_lock, "slot": slot} if slot is not None else base_lock
        with os.fdopen(fd, "w") as f:
            json.dump(lock, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
```

**The window**: `os.open(O_CREAT|O_EXCL)` creates the file (EMPTY) → then json.dump writes it. Between open and dump-complete, ANY other guard process calling `_read_lock(path)` sees an EMPTY file → json parse fails → `old.get("corrupt")` → "锁文件损坏 REFUSED" → the acquiring driver gets GuardFailure (F-023 immediate fail, no retry).

Also — worse: `_read_lock` marks corrupt and the SLOT scan hits it BEFORE trying to acquire → refuses. The D r4 (11:55), C02 (12:46), D r5 (13:01), claim test (14:4x), C02 resume (15:07) — all victims of this window. Frequency: whenever two guard acquires/releases overlap at µs-ms scale on the same slot... actually the read happens during ANY concurrent acquire-scan or release or gate — with 3-4 drivers cycling every ~8-40s, the window hits every ~30-90 min. That matches.

**The fix (OBS-FIX-4)**: create the lock atomically so readers never see a partial file:
Pattern: write to tmp file (pid-suffixed), then `os.link(tmp, path)` — link fails with EEXIST if path exists (preserving O_EXCL semantics atomically), then unlink tmp. link() is atomic: the path appears fully-written or not at all.

```python
        tmp = f"{path}.new.{os.getpid()}"
        with open(tmp, "w") as f:
            json.dump(lock, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
            f.flush()
            os.fsync(f.fileno())   # 内容先于 link 落盘
        try:
            os.link(tmp, path)      # 原子发布：读者永见完整 JSON 或不存在
        except FileExistsError:
            os.unlink(tmp)
            continue
        finally-ish...
        os.unlink(tmp)
```

Wait — os.link creates a hard link: path and tmp are the same inode. After link succeeds, unlink tmp → path remains with full content. Readers see either "not exists" (before link) or full content (after link — link is atomic metadata op). PERFECT — no empty-file window. EEXIST → another process won the slot → continue to next candidate. Same semantics as O_EXCL but atomic-content.

Edge: leftover tmp files on crash between write and link — they linger as `*.new.<pid>` files in the guard dir. They're not slot locks (name doesn't match experiment_slot_N.lock pattern) — harmless litter; could add cleanup of own tmp on exception. Note _read_lock/_slots_state glob for "experiment_slot_*.lock" (or similar) — the tmp name `experiment_slot_2.lock.new.123` — DANGER: does the slot scan glob match it?? If the glob is `experiment_slot_*.lock` then `...lock.new.123` does NOT match (doesn't end with .lock). Need to verify the glob pattern in _read_lock/_slots_state. Let me check how paths are enumerated (candidates come from... `_slot_lock_path(slot)` presumably; the scan iterates known slots 1..N reading specific paths). If paths are constructed (not globbed), tmp files never enter the scan. Check quickly.

Also the CLAIM file creation (line 433-434: `with os.fdopen(fd, "w")` — same pattern for claims!) — claim files have the same race ("claim 文件损坏" refusals at 427/453). Fix both create paths.

Also line 248 _write_lock_atomic (heartbeat) is already atomic ✓.

TDD plan (OBS-FIX-4):
- Test: concurrent hammer — N processes repeatedly: acquire slot lock (via _try_acquire or cmd path) + readers scanning, for T seconds; assert ZERO "锁文件损坏" refusals. On old code, the race is organic-but-rare (claim test hit it once organically). A deterministic repro: hard to hit µs window reliably... Need a sharper test: monkeypatch json.dump to sleep? For a unit test: patch `json.dump` (in the guard module) with a wrapper that sleeps 50ms mid-dump?? The window is between os.open and dump completion — injecting a delay inside the write makes the window deterministic: reader during that window sees partial → corrupt. Test: (1) spawn writer that acquires with injected slow-dump; (2) concurrently call _read_lock on the same path; (3) old code → corrupt=True at least once; new code (link) → never (path doesn't exist until fully written).
- Simpler deterministic test design:
  - subprocess A: python -c "import lsu_guard; monkeypatch json.dump to slow; acquire slot 1" — hmm, patching inside subprocess is awkward. Alternative: the test imports lsu_guard, monkeypatches `lsu_guard.json.dump` with a slow version, runs _try_acquire in a THREAD, and from the main thread repeatedly _read_locks the slot path. Old code: during the slow dump, path exists with partial/empty content → read returns corrupt. New code: path doesn't exist until link → read returns None (not corrupt).
  - This is deterministic with a 200ms injected delay.
- Also integration: run the existing claim concurrency test (its organic race may still rarely hit, but the deterministic unit test is the authority).
- Guard regression: tests/test_lsu_guard_v2.py exists — run it before/after.

Where to put the test: tests/test_lsu_guard_v2.py exists — extend it with a new check group, or a new test file. Let me look at test_lsu_guard_v2.py briefly for structure. Actually — time is pressing (C02 down). Plan: quick look at guard file enumeration + claim create path, write plan file, TDD, fix, test, commit, push, relaunch C02.

Also — should I make the DRIVER more resilient too (retry on corrupt/stale instead of immediate GuardFailure)? F-023 discipline says immediate fail for stale/corrupt — by design (保现场待查). Changing that = policy change, not mine to make. The guard-side atomic fix removes the corruption SOURCE (the false "损坏" from torn reads). True stale locks (dead pid holders) are a separate legitimate mechanism (needs clear-stale). The corruption race is the bug; fix that only.

> release/gate）读到空/半文件 → 判"锁文件损坏" → F-023 立即失败。

>   - C02 正式批 12:46（slot_1 陈旧）与 15:07（slot_2 损坏）

> 基线：fi-ding @b8be45aa。

`tmp 写全内容 + os.link 原子发布`：
1. 写 `{path}.tmp.{pid}.{tid}` 完整 JSON；
2. `os.link(tmp, path)`——link(2) 目标存在即 EEXIST，保持 O_EXCL 语义；
3. 读者从此只见"不存在"或"完整 JSON"，永不见空/半文件；
4. EEXIST → 走既有"已被占/损坏"分支；unlink tmp 清理。

文件，replace 语义正确。claim 与 slot 锁的**创建**路径是本单元范围。

占坑分支）；tmp 名含 pid+tid 不冲突；crash 遗留 tmp 不匹配
`experiment_slot_*.lock`/claim glob，不污染扫描。

    # 内容——并发读者读到空/半文件即判"锁文件损坏"（F-023 立即失败）。
    # 修复 = tmp 写全内容 + os.link 原子发布（读者只见"不存在"或完整）。
    import threading
    gd2 = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="guard_atomic_"))
    old_gd = G.GUARD_DIR
    G.GUARD_DIR = str(gd2)
    orig_dump = G.json.dump
    torn_seen = []
    acquired = {}

    def slow_dump(obj, fh, **kw):
        fh.write('{"torn": ')          # 模拟 dump 写入中（半文件）
        fh.flush()
        time.sleep(0.5)                # 窗口确定性放大
        fh.seek(0)
        fh.truncate()
        orig_dump(obj, fh, **kw)

    def writer():
        G.json.dump = slow_dump
        try:
            acquired["lock"], acquired["err"] = G._try_acquire(
                "experiment", "atomic-window-test")
        finally:
            G.json.dump = orig_dump

    th = threading.Thread(target=writer)
    th.start()
    deadline = time.time() + 1.2
    while time.time() < deadline and th.is_alive():
        p5 = gd2 / "experiment_slot_5.lock"
        if p5.exists():
            raw = p5.read_bytes()
            if raw:
                try:
                    json.loads(raw)
                    torn_seen.append(("ok", len(raw)))
                except Exception:
                    torn_seen.append(("TORN", len(raw)))
        time.sleep(0.02)
    th.join()
    G.GUARD_DIR = old_gd
    check("r1_no_torn_lock_visible",
          not torn_seen and acquired.get("lock") is not None,
          f"torn={torn_seen[:4]} lock={acquired.get('lock')} "
          f"err={acquired.get('err')}")

    # ---- 10) 并发抢占：16 进程 × 6 槽恰 6 成功，锁全可解析，无 tmp 残留 ----
    gd3 = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="guard_race_"))
    env3 = {"LSU_GUARD_DIR": str(gd3), "LSU_GUARD_SLOTS": "6"}
    procs = [subprocess.Popen(
        [sys.executable, str(GUARD), "acquire", "--type", "experiment",
         "--desc", f"race{i}"], stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
        stderr=subprocess.PIPE, text=True, env={**os.environ, **env3})
        for i in range(16)]
    rcs = [p.wait() for p in procs]
    n_ok = sum(1 for rc in rcs if rc == 0)
    parsed = []
    for s in range(6):

    leftovers = list(gd3.glob("*.tmp.*"))
    check("r2_race_exactly_6_win",
          n_ok == 6 and len(parsed) == 6,

    check("r2_no_tmp_leftover", not leftovers, str(leftovers))

    # 清场：处置测试进程写下的 claim（陈旧：子进程已退出）
    run_guard(env, "clear-stale", "--type", "claim", "--confirm-dead-pid", "0")

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""test_lsu_guard_v2.py — guard v2 语义单测（隔离 LSU_GUARD_DIR，绝不碰主锁目录）。

覆盖（LSU OBS 计划 T1，用户指令 2026-10-12 三.1）：
  1  LSU_GUARD_SLOTS 槽位数化 + experiment 降序抢占（先占高位槽）
  2  锁记录 pid_start；PID 复用（活 PID + 错误 starttime）必须判陈旧并拒绝
  3  clear-stale 可处置 pid_start 不符的"复用 PID"锁（--confirm-dead-pid 匹配）
  4  claim 锁 O_EXCL 唯一 + 拒绝他人释放 + status 可见
  5  STOP_DISPATCH 阈值（<10GiB 停止加任务）
  6  磁盘红线 max(50GiB, 20%×total)
  7  心跳原子重写（tmp+replace，读者永见完整 JSON）
  8  向后兼容：v1 旧格式锁（无 pid_start）可解析、存活判定退化为纯 PID

用法：python3 tests/test_lsu_guard_v2.py   （退出码 0=全 PASS）
"""
import json
import os
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import time
from pathlib import Path

HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
GUARD = HERE.parent / "tools" / "lsu_guard.py"


def run_guard(env, *argv):
    r = subprocess.run([sys.executable, str(GUARD), *argv],
                       capture_output=True, text=True, env={**os.environ, **env})
    return r.returncode, r.stdout, r.stderr


def forge_lock(path, pid, pid_start, slot, desc="forged"):
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    path.write_text(json.dumps({
        "owner": "test", "pid": pid, "pgid": pid, "pid_start": pid_start,
        "task_type": "experiment", "desc": desc,
        "started": "2026-01-01 00:00:00", "slot": slot}))


def main():
    tmp = tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="guard_v2_test_")
    env = {"LSU_GUARD_DIR": tmp, "LSU_GUARD_SLOTS": "6"}
    fails = []

    def check(name, cond, detail=""):
        print(("PASS" if cond else "FAIL"), name, "" if cond else f"  <- {detail}")
        if not cond:
            fails.append(name)

    # ---- 1) 槽位数化 + 降序抢占：空目录首取应拿 slot 5，其次 4 ----
    rc, out, err = run_guard(env, "acquire", "--type", "experiment", "--desc", "t1")
    lock = json.loads(out) if rc == 0 else {}
    check("slots_env_and_descending_first_takes_5",
          rc == 0 and lock.get("slot") == 5, f"rc={rc} out={out!r} err={err!r}")
    check("pid_start_recorded", isinstance(lock.get("pid_start"), int), out)
    check("campaign_sample_fields",
          lock.get("campaign") is None and lock.get("sample") is None, out)
    # acquire 子进程已退出 -> 该槽为陈旧锁：先按 F-023 语义确认拒绝，再显式处置
    rc_stale, _, err_stale = run_guard(env, "acquire", "--type", "experiment", "--desc", "t1b")
    check("dead_pid_slot_is_stale_refusal",
          rc_stale != 0 and "陈旧" in err_stale, err_stale)
    rc_cs, out_cs, _ = run_guard(env, "clear-stale", "--type", "experiment",
                                 "--confirm-dead-pid", str(lock.get("pid")))
    check("clear_stale_dead_pid", rc_cs == 0 and "CLEARED" in out_cs, out_cs)

    # 伪造"活"锁（pid=本测试进程 + 正确 pid_start）占 slot 5 -> 下一个应拿 slot 4
    sys.path.insert(0, str(GUARD.parent))
    os.environ.update(env)
    import lsu_guard as G  # noqa: E402  （env 已设，模块常量按 v2 语义加载）
    my_start = G._pid_start_ticks(os.getpid())
    forge_lock(Path(tmp, "experiment_slot_5.lock"), os.getpid(), my_start, 5, "live5")
    rc2, out2, err2 = run_guard(env, "acquire", "--type", "experiment", "--desc", "t2")
    check("live_lock_skipped_next_takes_4",
          rc2 == 0 and json.loads(out2).get("slot") == 4, f"rc={rc2} err={err2!r}")
    # live5 的使命（验证活锁被跳过）已完成，移除测试产物——否则后续 clear-stale
    # 会因它仍存活而 rc=2（正确行为，但会干扰下述断言）
    Path(tmp, "experiment_slot_5.lock").unlink()
    # t2 的 acquire 子进程已退出 -> slot 4 留下陈旧锁，先显式处置，
    # 保证后续"复用 PID 拒绝"测试指向 slot 0 而非 slot 4
    rc_cs_t2, out_cs_t2, _ = run_guard(env, "clear-stale", "--type", "experiment",
                                       "--confirm-dead-pid",
                                       str(json.loads(out2).get("pid")))
    check("clear_stale_t2", rc_cs_t2 == 0 and "CLEARED" in out_cs_t2, out_cs_t2)

    # ---- 2) PID 复用免疫：活 PID + 错误 starttime -> 陈旧 ----
    forge_lock(Path(tmp, "experiment_slot_0.lock"), os.getpid(), 1, 0, "recycled")
    check("lock_live_rejects_recycled_pid",
          G._lock_live(json.loads(Path(tmp, "experiment_slot_0.lock").read_text())) is False)
    check("lock_live_accepts_genuine",
          G._lock_live({"pid": os.getpid(), "pid_start": my_start}) is True)
    check("lock_live_v1_compat_no_pid_start",
          G._lock_live({"pid": os.getpid()}) is True)
    rc3, _, err3 = run_guard(env, "acquire", "--type", "experiment", "--desc", "t3")
    check("recycled_pid_slot_refused_on_acquire",
          rc3 != 0 and "陈旧" in err3 and "slot 0" in err3, err3)

    # ---- 3) clear-stale 处置复用 PID 锁（pid 活但 pid_start 不符） ----
    rc_cs2, out_cs2, _ = run_guard(env, "clear-stale", "--type", "experiment",
                                   "--confirm-dead-pid", str(os.getpid()))
    check("clear_stale_recycled_pid",
          rc_cs2 == 0 and "CLEARED" in out_cs2, f"rc={rc_cs2} out={out_cs2!r}")

    # ---- 4) claim 锁：进程内 acquire 唯一性 + 他人释放拒绝 + status 可见 ----
    c1, r1 = G._claim_acquire("campX", "A01-F0-W9", "s322", "driver-A")
    c2, r2 = G._claim_acquire("campX", "A01-F0-W9", "s322", "driver-B")
    check("claim_exclusive_inproc", c1 is not None and c2 is None and "REFUSED" in r2, r2)
    ok, msg, _ = G._claim_release("campX", "A01-F0-W9", "s322", confirm_pid=999999)
    check("claim_release_wrong_pid_refused", ok is False, msg)
    ok2, msg2, _ = G._claim_release("campX", "A01-F0-W9", "s322",
                                    confirm_pid=os.getpid())
    check("claim_release_ok", ok2 is True, msg2)
    rc_ca, out_ca, err_ca = run_guard(env, "claim-acquire", "--campaign", "campCLI",
                                      "--runid", "R", "--sample", "s0", "--desc", "d")
    check("claim_cli_creates_file",
          rc_ca == 0 and Path(tmp, "claims/campCLI/R/s0.claim").exists(), err_ca)
    rc_st, out_st, _ = run_guard(env, "status")
    check("claims_in_status", rc_st == 0 and "campCLI" in out_st, out_st[:300])
    check("status_shows_beyond_configured_slots", "slot_5" in out_st, out_st[:300])
    check("status_shows_configured_cap",
          '"experiment_slots_configured": 6' in out_st, out_st[:300])

    # ---- 5) STOP_DISPATCH ----
    snap = {"mem_available_gib": 9.5, "swap_free_gib": 14.0}
    check("stop_dispatch_below_10", G._stop_dispatch(snap) is True)
    snap["mem_available_gib"] = 16.0
    check("stop_dispatch_ok_at_16", G._stop_dispatch(snap) is False)

    # ---- 6) 磁盘红线 ----
    check("disk_guard_20pct_dominates",
          G._disk_guard_reason(free_gib=60.0, total_gib=354.0) is not None)
    check("disk_guard_50gib_floor",
          G._disk_guard_reason(free_gib=45.0, total_gib=100.0) is not None)
    check("disk_guard_pass", G._disk_guard_reason(free_gib=90.0, total_gib=354.0) is None)

    # ---- 7) 心跳原子重写 ----
    lp = Path(tmp, "experiment_slot_2.lock")
    lp.write_text(json.dumps({"pid": 1, "desc": "hb"}))
    G._write_lock_atomic(str(lp), {"pid": 1, "desc": "hb", "heartbeat": "T1"})
    time.sleep(0.01)
    G._write_lock_atomic(str(lp), {"pid": 1, "desc": "hb", "heartbeat": "T2"})
    check("heartbeat_atomic_valid_json",
          json.loads(lp.read_text())["heartbeat"] == "T2")
    leftovers = list(Path(tmp).glob("*.tmp.*"))
    check("heartbeat_no_tmp_leftover", not leftovers, str(leftovers))

    # ---- 8) 旧格式锁（v1，无 pid_start）可解析 + 槽上限校验 ----
    p0 = Path(tmp, "experiment_slot_3.lock")
    p0.write_text(json.dumps({"owner": "x", "pid": -1, "pgid": -1,
                              "task_type": "experiment", "desc": "oldstyle",
                              "started": "x", "slot": 3}))
    check("v1_lock_parses", G._read_lock("experiment", 3).get("desc") == "oldstyle")
    rc_over, _, err_over = run_guard({"LSU_GUARD_DIR": tmp, "LSU_GUARD_SLOTS": "9"},
                                      "status")
    check("slots_cap_enforced_at_8",
          rc_over != 0 and "LSU_GUARD_SLOTS" in err_over, err_over)

    # 清场：处置测试进程写下的 claim（陈旧：子进程已退出）
    run_guard(env, "clear-stale", "--type", "claim", "--confirm-dead-pid", "0")
    print(f"\nFAILURES: {fails if fails else '无'}")
    return 1 if fails else 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

def _write_lock_atomic(path, lock):
    """原子重写锁文件（tmp + os.replace）：心跳/派生信息更新期间读者永见完整 JSON。"""
    tmp = f"{path}.tmp.{os.getpid()}"

    os.replace(tmp, path)


def _publish_json_exclusive(path, obj):
    """OBS-FIX-4（2026-10-14）：原子创建锁/claim 文件。

    旧路径 O_CREAT|O_EXCL 先落**空文件**、json.dump 后才有内容——窗口期
    内并发读者（其他 driver 的 acquire 扫描/release/gate）读到空/半文件
    即判"锁文件损坏"→ F-023 立即失败（2026-10-14 五次进程死亡根因：
    D 11:55/13:01、C02 12:46/15:07、claim 测试 14:44）。

    新路径：tmp 写全内容 + os.link 原子发布。link(2) 目标存在即 EEXIST
    （保持 O_EXCL 语义），读者从此只见"不存在"或"完整 JSON"。
    返回 True=发布成功；False=EEXIST（撞槽/撞 claim，走既有占坑分支）。
    crash 遗留 tmp 不匹配 experiment_slot_*.lock / claim glob，不污染扫描。
    """
    tmp = f"{path}.tmp.{os.getpid()}.{time.time_ns()}"
    try:
        with open(tmp, "w") as f:
            json.dump(obj, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
            f.flush()
            os.fsync(f.fileno())
        try:
            os.link(tmp, path)
        except FileExistsError:
            os.unlink(tmp)
            return False
        os.unlink(tmp)
        return True
    except OSError:
        try:
            os.unlink(tmp)
        except OSError:
            pass
        raise

# 与 lsu_batch_supervisor.sh 同款理念：driver 退出且未 COMPLETE → 原命令重拉；

# 停止条件：COMPLETE / BLOCKED_ATTEMPT_CAP / 40 轮上限 / touch C02_WATCHER.STOP
set -u
MT=/home/sdc/gem5-fi-ding
LOG=$MT/runs/lsu/obs/c02_watcher.log
STOP=$MT/runs/lsu/obs/C02_WATCHER.STOP
CAMPAIGN=p5_formal_full_c02_f0_w6
DRIVER_LOG=$MT/runs/lsu/obs/formal_c02_resume_watch.log
export LSU_GEM5_BIN=$MT/.claude/worktrees/lsu-obs/build/ARM/gem5.opt
export LSU_GUARD_DIR=$MT/runs/lsu/guard
export PYTHONHASHSEED=0
log(){ echo "[$(date '+%F %T')] $*" >> $LOG; }
drivers_running(){ pgrep -f "lsu_obs_driver\.py --items ITEM-127" 2>/dev/null | grep -v $$ | wc -l; }
log "watcher start (pid $$)"
for i in $(seq 1 40); do
  [ -f "$STOP" ] && { log "STOP 文件存在，watcher 退出"; exit 0; }
  st=$(python3 -c "import json;print(json.load(open('$MT/runs/lsu/obs/$CAMPAIGN/driver_summary.json'))['items']['ITEM-127'])" 2>/dev/null || echo MISSING)
  act=$(python3 - << 'PY' 2>/dev/null || echo '?'
import glob, json
ps = glob.glob('/home/sdc/gem5-fi-ding/runs/lsu/obs/p5_formal_full_c02_f0_w6/ITEM-127/ITEM-127_s*/observation.json')
print(sum(1 for p in ps if json.load(open(p))['L5'].get('activated')))
PY
)
  log "round $i: status=$st activated=$act/385"
  case "$st" in
    COMPLETE)          log "COMPLETE，watcher 退出"; exit 0 ;;
    BLOCKED_ATTEMPT_CAP) log "BLOCKED_ATTEMPT_CAP 终态，watcher 退出"; exit 0 ;;

  if [ "$(drivers_running)" -ge 1 ]; then

    cd $MT
    nohup python3 tools/lsu_obs_driver.py --items ITEM-127 --phase screening \
      --campaign $CAMPAIGN --target 385 --cap 3850 --workers 1 \
      --replay-policy per_runid_first \
      --outdir-root $MT/runs/lsu/obs \
      --gem5-bin $LSU_GEM5_BIN >> $DRIVER_LOG 2>&1 &
  fi
  sleep 120
done
log "40 轮上限达到，退出（人工接管）"
